Why Coastal C

Detailing done the right way

Every vehicle gets the same standard: careful hand work, premium products, and an eye for the details that get missed at the drive-through wash.

Premium Products

Professional-grade soaps, microfiber tools, and interior treatments — never a cheap shortcut.

Attention to Detail

Door jambs, water spots, wheel wells — the spots other washes skip are where we start.

Satisfaction Guaranteed

We're not finished until you're happy with the result. Every time, no exceptions.

Mobile Service

We come to you — home, office, or driveway — anywhere along the coast.
